02 — Unfinished stories

Journal

Three entries. None of them end properly. That is rather the point.

No. 01

The Door Left Open

+

Somebody left the light on in a house nobody lives in.

Entry 01 — kept open

Somebody left the light on in a house nobody lives in. I walked past it for a week before I understood it wasn't a mistake.

On the eighth day I stopped walking past.

No. 02

A Map With One Street

+

I found it folded inside a library book.

Entry 02 — undecided

I found it folded inside a library book. One street, no name, and a small cross where a shop should be.

I haven't decided whether to go.

No. 03

What the Tide Kept

+

Three keys, one shoe, and a letter I can't read.

Entry 03 — ongoing

Three keys, one shoe, and a letter I can't read. I kept all of it.

More soon.

— the end, or near it
